svg.title: RB2.1 — 04a Usage history v1
svg.desc: The usage screen opens with two tab pills. Usage history shows the modelled use profile beside a floating DACH map whose orange traces are the driven corridors and whose dot sizes are kilometres attributed. Service history shows a ghost car with hotspots on the serviced systems; pinching one fills the panel with that system events.
svg.text: USAGE HISTORY — panel + floating DACH map
floating world-space object — not on the panel
SERVICE HISTORY — panel + floating ghost car
floating world-space object — not on the panel
pinch a hotspot — the panel fills with its events
gold = the unit you are holding
HOTSPOT SELECTED — the panel becomes the log, no overlay
vehicle would not wake from sleep
root cause traced to charge management, fixed in v10.0
the car stays — only the panel changed
Orange #f08a3c is NOT in the palette - 00 s.2 needs a route/trace token, or the traces use teal
Map geometry is generated from usage_map (14 cities, 53 route-years); local + trip km == 225,000
Country outlines are omitted here - the final asset needs a public-domain boundary (Natural Earth)
No overlay anywhere: selecting a hotspot swaps the PANEL content, it does not float a modal
A movement profile is personal data. Shown to both roles by decision 2026-08-06 - note it in Limitations
